subject: history
concept: Applying personal history and timeline skills to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple timeline of a topic they're interested in (e.g. how their favorite thing has changed)
exercise.abstract: Student explains their timeline in a short spoken or written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: timeline shows correct chronological order with at least 2 real points
misconception_flags: timeline events are not in correct chronological order

interest_binding: timeline topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
